description: Unified four-group experiment matrix for Static Top-1, Fixed Threshold Gate, Dynamic Recovery (No Belief-State), and Lite Belief-State under the frozen issue209 task set and high-cost rules.

high_cost_rules.label: 结构映射
high_cost_rules.rationale: Structure prediction calls consume the main high-cost model budget.

high_cost_rules.label: 结构条件下的序列精修
high_cost_rules.rationale: Iterative backbone-conditioned sequence refinement is expensive and recovery-heavy.

high_cost_rules.label: 重型目标评估
high_cost_rules.rationale: Heavy multi-objective scoring or remote property evaluation adds significant evaluation cost.

groups.label: 静态 Top-1
groups.notes: Pure static baseline with a single recommended candidate and no runtime adaptation.

groups.label: 固定阈值 gate
groups.notes: Uses current fixed score/risk/cost thresholds without explicit runtime state.

groups.label: Lite belief-state
groups.notes: Lite belief-state baseline with runtime rerank and adaptive action selection enabled.

tasks.rationale: Requires stable fold formation and balanced structural evidence, but objective pressure is moderate.
